capabilities.description: Use for Jira or Confluence issues, projects, pages, spaces, comments, or attachments that need typed reads or guarded changes; choose GitHub for repository work, and compose with enterprise-newsletter when these sources feed a brief.
Use when creating, editing, QAing, or exporting in Claude Design. Can manage projects and native exports; use Image Studio for standalone images.

Use to search, inspect, install, validate, update, or roll back ClawPod capabilities and activate registry-first WORKFLOW policy; it manages capability packages rather than performing their domain work, so route onward after selection.

Use to onboard, inspect, audit, preview, change, or verify ClawPod Cloud webhook sources, playbooks, rules, and events; it does not host arbitrary webhooks, while Quick Tunnel can separately expose a temporary local preview.

Use to generate, edit, compare, inspect, or QA images with OpenAI, Vertex, BFL, or Recraft and manage jobs and artifacts; send assets to Claude Design or Video Studio instead of building decks or videos here.

Use to extract Korean or English text from bounded PDFs and images, inspect or export OCR results, create comparison DOCX reports, or apply approved Ollama correction; it does not edit documents, and Verified Research verifies claims.

Use to plan, create, edit, repurpose, localize, resume, export, or quality-check videos through guarded OpenMontage pipelines with costs and checkpoints; use Image Studio for standalone still-image work or source images.

Use to preflight, start, inspect, or stop a TTL-bounded accountless Cloudflare Quick Tunnel for a loopback-only local preview; pair it with a local server, never production hosting, named tunnels, custom domains, or persistent exposure.

Use to onboard Codex or Claude, register projects, and coordinate cross-process coding sessions, leases, and git context; use ordinary coding for in-process edits and GitHub for remote repository operations.

Use for native apps or OS dialogs when no typed API or DOM fits. Observe and operate pointer/keyboard, windows/dialogs, or drag/drop; QA, verify, recover. Prefer Browser for DOM, nodes for remote screens, provider APIs for services.

Use to validate, render, inspect, or release-bind enterprise newsletters and capability catalogs without sending; compose evidence with Verified Research and hand approved delivery to Resend Email, not personal news digests.

Use for guarded GitHub repository, issue, pull-request, Actions-run, release, branch-push, or bounded API operations through gh; choose Atlassian for Jira and Project Development for durable coding-agent orchestration.

Use to onboard Google OAuth and manage supported Gmail mail, Calendar events and ACLs, or Drive files, permissions, comments, and shared drives; it is not Outlook or generic web automation and can feed Enterprise Newsletter.

Use to build, reconcile, query, validate, or export a private evidence graph when connected history across decisions, people, projects, causes, effects, or events is needed; use Memory Search for simple source-fact lookup, not this graph.

Use to onboard or perform guarded reads and supported writes for Notion pages, blocks, data sources, comments, files, users, and webhooks; choose another platform for non-Notion documents and Verified Research for sourced claims.
Onboard a ClawPod node on Mac/Windows through approved Tailscale and SSH-server plans, then install, pair, and verify. Use node-connect for diagnostics.

Use to onboard Resend, verify senders, preview messages, attach files, or deliver transactional email retry-safely; use Google Workspace for inbox management and Enterprise Newsletter to compose approved content.

Use to onboard, discover, preview, mount, restore, or unmount Synology SMB shares and enforce artifact layout or WORKFLOW policy; it is not cloud object storage or general NAS administration, but can store capability outputs.

Use when factual claims need citations, cross-checking, contradiction handling, confidence, or evidence bundles; skip unsupported browsing, brainstorming, and pure editing, and compose with YouTube Evidence Analysis for videos.

Use to normalize YouTube references, import supplied transcripts, extract description links, or validate timestamped video evidence; it cannot watch videos or acquire captions, so use Verified Research to check external claims.
Execute typed Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud operations with stable JSON, retries, and guarded mutations.
Use when creating, editing, QAing, or exporting in Claude Design. Can manage projects and native exports; use Image Studio for standalone images.
Canonical capability registry lifecycle with digest verification and transactional registry-first WORKFLOW onboarding.
Execute guarded ClawPod Cloud Webhooks operations with protected onboarding, redaction, previews, and verified readback.
Guarded detached OpenAI image jobs plus offline professional planning, review, finishing, proofing, and deterministic delivery.
Bounded local Korean and English OCR with enterprise comparison DOCX reports and optional guarded Ollama correction.
Execute guarded OpenMontage tools, pipelines, detached jobs, provider verification, media QA, and transactional runtime lifecycle operations.
Create TTL-bounded accountless Cloudflare Quick Tunnel previews for loopback-only local services.
Develop software projects with Codex and/or Claude across separate processes with canonical git context, leases, protected secrets, and fail-closed state.

Use for native apps or OS dialogs when no typed API or DOM fits. Observe and operate pointer/keyboard, windows/dialogs, or drag/drop; QA, verify, recover. Prefer Browser for DOM, nodes for remote screens, provider APIs for services.
Validate complete bounded newsletter JSON, render brand tokens with computed HTML/text parity, inspect, and release-bind locally without credentials, Gateway calls, or email delivery.
Execute guarded GitHub operations, including verified repository bootstrap, guarded existing-repository branch push, and release body-only updates, through the real gh CLI.
Execute typed Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and agent-desktop OAuth operations with stable JSON and safety controls.
Deterministically export validated inert candidates or approved causal snapshots as fully offline interactive SVG node-link HTML.
Execute typed guarded Notion REST operations with protected-secret onboarding, previews, verification, and stable JSON.
Onboard a ClawPod node on Mac/Windows through approved Tailscale and SSH-server plans, then install, pair, and verify. Use node-connect for diagnostics.
Guarded Resend email with per-run Gateway memory-secret injection, protected onboarding, verified senders, previews, and retry-safe delivery.
Guarded SMB 3.1.1 credentials, discovery, mount lifecycle and recovery, status, layout, and WORKFLOW policy operations for Synology NAS storage.
Capture, normalize, hash, bundle, inspect, and validate bounded public research evidence deterministically.
Normalize YouTube references, import explicit transcripts, extract safe links, and validate timestamped evidence deterministically.
